title: ST_AsText
description: Returns the Well-Known Text string representation of a geometry or geography.
kernels:
  - returns: string
    args: [geometry]
  - returns: string
    args: [geography]
  - returns: string
    args:
      - geometry
      - name: max_decimal_digits
        type: integer
        description: >
          Number of digits after the decimal point, from 0 to 16. Rounds coordinates
          and removes trailing zeros. Omitting this argument preserves full precision.
  - returns: string
    args: [geography, max_decimal_digits]
---

## Description

Alias: `ST_AsWKT`.

## Examples

```sql
SELECT ST_AsText(ST_Point(1.0, 2.0));
```

```sql
SELECT ST_AsText(ST_GeogPoint(1.0, 2.0));
```

```sql
SELECT ST_AsText(ST_Point(1.123456789, 2.5), 6);
-- POINT (1.123457 2.5)
```
